# Nafiz Khan | Independent Copywriter

> Nafiz Khan writes emails, sales pages, and landing pages for small businesses and creators who need clearer copy.

## Samples

- [Featured samples](https://spacyg.github.io/nafizkhan/#work): Practice projects for fictional brands, with draft and rewrite comparisons.
- [Full writing portfolio](https://spacyg.github.io/nafizkhan/work.html): Browse email, sales page, and landing page practice projects.

## Process and pricing

- [How working together works](https://spacyg.github.io/nafizkhan/#process): Follow a project from the first brief through a quote, draft, and delivery.
- [Pricing approach](https://spacyg.github.io/nafizkhan/#pricing): One fixed price per project, agreed before work starts, never per word or per hour.

## About and contact

- [About Nafiz](https://spacyg.github.io/nafizkhan/#about): Learn about Nafiz Khan, an independent copywriter in Bangladesh.
- [Contact Nafiz](https://spacyg.github.io/nafizkhan/#contact): Send a project inquiry or get in touch by email.
